comment: Integration tier registry. Static metadata only — per-user connections live in the user_integrations table (UserIntegration). Tier drives whether/how an integration surfaces to the user: brokered (invisible, platform infra), oauth (one-tap, contextual), advanced (hidden unless sought). 'runtime_provider' is the UserIntegration.provider key; null for brokered (no per-user row).

integrations.benefit_copy: Outreach and sequence sends run on Simulacrum's own email infrastructure.
integrations.powered_by_note: Sends on the platform domain with your name as sender.

integrations.benefit_copy: Prospect research and contact discovery run on the platform's Apollo seats.
integrations.powered_by_note: Runs on platform seats — no account needed.

integrations.benefit_copy: Proposals, SOWs and agreements are generated and sent on the platform account.
integrations.powered_by_note: You review drafts; recipients sign. No account needed.

integrations.contextual_prompt: To get paid, connect your account to receive payments.
To let prospects book calls with you, connect your calendar.
To update your LinkedIn profile, connect your account.

integrations.benefit_copy: Publish courses, memberships and landing pages to your existing Kajabi account.
integrations.advanced_note: Default: hosted on Simulacrum. Connect Kajabi to publish to your own account.

integrations.benefit_copy: Publish newsletters and lead magnets to your existing ConvertKit list.
integrations.advanced_note: Default: platform-brokered email. Connect ConvertKit to publish to your own list.

integrations.benefit_copy: Automate dollar-cost-averaging through your own brokerage.
integrations.advanced_note: Brokerage for DCA automation. Opt-in only, after Layer 5 activates.
